text:
Maya: quick sync: form validation patterns for the new Routes editor. Two main debates: show inline errors as-you-type or only after submit, and how aggressive should delete confirmations be?
Omar: for deterministic checks (format, length) validate live. For required/missing fields wait until submit to avoid noise.
Lin: agree. Also we should stop using asterisks alone. Visible "Required" helper or section-level legend + `aria-required="true"` on inputs.
Tess: copy nit: prefer action-first messages ("Enter a name") vs passive ("Name is required"). Tests show clearer context.
Maya: delete modal currently ambiguous. Proposal: single-item delete = checkbox "I understand this cannot be undone"; bulk or prod-tagged = typed confirm of the resource name. Explicit wording: "Permanently delete route "<name>". This cannot be undone. Type the route name to confirm."
Omar: also focus management: after submit with errors, move focus to an error summary (tabindex=-1) that links into fields. Inline errors that appear should use `role="alert"`.
Lin: visual guidance: no color-only states. Use icon + text and ensure contrast for error copy >= 4.5:1.
a11y-bot: checklist posted: https://intranet.redwood/a11y/checklist
Maya: plan: Omar will prototype live vs submit flows in Figma, Lin will draft accessible field markup snippets, Tess will prepare two copy variants. reconvene after mocks.
Omar: will post mocks by EOD.
Tess: copy in #docs by tomorrow.
Lin: will open a small PR with `aria-invalid` + summary focus wiring behind flag.
